title: Ghost on the Wire
summary: Someone is listening to the family's radio. Panam wants Carol's device planted on the Raffen relay above Vasquez Pass, unseen.
description: Someone is listening to the family's radio. Panam has traced a Raffen relay mast above Vasquez Pass that hears every run, and she wants Carol's device planted on it unseen.

start.bringUp: The Raffen hear every run the family plans. Carol traced it to a relay mast above Vasquez Pass. Bring up, in your own way, that you want to plant Carol's device on it quietly.

meet.name: the camp where the trucks are parked

ridge-foot.name: the foot of the ridge above Vasquez Pass

relay.name: the Raffen relay mast on the ridge above Vasquez Pass

hut.name: the junction hut at the foot of the relay mast

P4.call.01.text: Someone's listening to the family's radio. Every run we plan, the Raffen are waiting.

P4.call.02.text: Carol traced it. A relay mast on the ridge above Vasquez Pass.

P4.call.03.text: I don't want it blown up. I want it lying for us.

P4.call.04.text: Carol built a box. Somebody plants it, nobody sees, and the Raffen hear what we want them to.

P4.call.05.text: Then come to the camp. I'll show you the box.

P4.brief.01.text: This is it. Tape it to the junction box in the hut, hold it there ten seconds.

P4.brief.02.text: If they see you, it's useless. If they see you, you also die. Mostly the first part bothers me.

P4.brief.03.text: When I was a kid the Raffen took a friend of mine. Cassidy got her back. Quietly.

P4.brief.04.text: Forget that. Point is, quiet works.

P4.approach.01.text: I stay with the truck, lights off. You climb. I'll be in your ear.

P4.plant.01.text: Two on the path, one in the hut. They swap every couple of minutes.

P4.plant.04.text: It's talking. Carol says it's talking. Get out of there.

P4.plant.05.text: They've got you. Forget the box, I'm coming up.

P4.exfil.01.text: In. Head down. No lights till the highway.

P4.exfil.02.text: Ghosts. They'll be chasing ghosts for a month.

P4.exfil.03.text: My plan, my mistake. Not yours. Don't argue.

P4.exfil.04.text: First lie's going out tonight. Want to pick it?

P4.end.01.text: Carol wants to kiss you. I told her to get in line.

P4.end.02.text: Next time we plan it together. Properly.

P4.end.03.text: Mitch went up the ridge instead. He's too old for it and too stubborn to say.

P4.bark.01a.text: That's the last of them. Breathe.

P4.bark.03.text: Still there? Talk to me, V.

g1.know: A relay mast above Vasquez Pass feeds the Raffen everything the family plans. Carol built a device that can lie for them. Five Raffen patrol the ridge. You want no war and no dead Aldecaldos.
g1.secret: She would go up herself if she trusted her own patience.

g2.asks: Any questions before you go up there and get yourself shot?
g2.know: The patrol, the hut, and the ten seconds the device needs at the junction box.
g2.secret: The childhood friend. She only says it after this gap.

g3.asks: What lie are we feeding them tonight? Make it ridiculous.
g3.know: The device works, and the Raffen will hear whatever the family sends them.
g3.wants: V's invented lie, the more ridiculous the better.

stages.label: Panam calls about the relay
stages.objective: Answer Panam's call about the Raffen relay at the camp
stages.know: Panam has traced a Raffen relay above Vasquez Pass that hears every family run. She wants to plant Carol's device on it and has a question for V.
stages.wants: V to say yes, say loud, or refuse.

stages.label: Panam briefs V on the plant
stages.objective: Listen to Panam's briefing on the plant at the camp
stages.know: Carol's device goes on the junction box in the hut at the relay foot. Five Raffen patrol the ridge and one netrunner works the hut.
stages.wants: V calm and ready to go up.

stages.label: Panam drives V to the ridge foot
stages.objective: Drive Panam to the foot of the ridge above Vasquez Pass
stages.know: V drives to the foot of the ridge. Panam takes the getaway seat in the truck, lights off, and V climbs alone.

stages.label: V climbs to the relay hut and plants the device
stages.objective: Climb to the relay hut and plant Carol's device unseen with Panam
stages.know: The relay mast sits on the ridge above Vasquez Pass. Five Raffen patrol two spots, and a netrunner works the hut at the mast's foot. V must reach the hut's junction box unseen and stay ten seconds.
stages.wants: V to plant the box and get out unseen.

stages.label: Panam drives V off the ridge, lights off
stages.objective: Get out with Panam, lights off, down to the highway
stages.know: The device is planted and nobody saw. Panam drives V down to the highway with the lights off.
stages.wants: V to pick the first lie for the Raffen to hear.

stages.label: Panam pulls V out after the Raffen spot the car
stages.objective: Get out with Panam down the highway below Vasquez Pass
stages.know: The Raffen spotted V at the relay. The device is useless. Panam is driving V out with the lights off.

planted.memory: You and Panam turned the Raffen's own relay against them, and now they hear only what the family wants them to hear.

burned.memory: You were spotted at the Raffen relay and Panam pulled you out. The plan failed, and she blames herself for it.

nobody.memory: You turned down Panam's relay plan, so Mitch went up the ridge instead.
